adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` changed the fallback calendar selection to `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` when `externalCalendarId` is falsy. In that branch `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, so the predicate effectively becomes `cal.externalId === undefined`, which will not match any real calendar externalId. This makes the fallback always yield `undefined`, so the methods will fall back to whatever default calendarId logic exists later (commonly `primary`) rather than the event’s destination calendar, leading to incorrect calendar targeting and likely 404s when the event lives in a non-primary calendar.
